threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the 242 is a reliable option over the busier 38. Welcome to our world of delayed buses and Tube strikes!
The 37 bus driver last night was blasting drum and bass, and half the passengers started dancing in the aisles. Only in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a whole family of ducks waddling down the sidewalk, without a care in the world. Only in Neukölln, right?

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you order a currywurst at 3 AM from a food truck parked right next to a techno club. Talk about late-night Berlin!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a real local knows that the best tacos are at the cart by the park after a Friday night BART mess, not at the trendy spots.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy on the 31 Balboa give his spare sandwich to a tourist. Classic Tenderloin moment—grit meets generosity right on that crowded bus.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think the best tapas are at La Rambla. But the real gems are hidden in the little bars around the plaza del Sol.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new by their struggle with the metro maps—Sagrada Família still has them wide-eyed while the locals rush by.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the 'East London Line' instead of just a 'train to Shoreditch'. You'll quickly learn the lingo or risk looking like a newbie.
Caught a night bus from Brixton to Clapham last week; a woman was singing Amy Winehouse so well, the driver had to pull over for a minute.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard the busker outside my window playing an accordion version of 'Wonderwall' while the neighbor yelled at their dog. That’s Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a karaoke bar that serves currywurst and has a stage dive from the balcony. It’s chaotic but unforgettable!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local when they know which taco truck stays open past midnight and can navigate the bus delays like it's a game of Frogger.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a guy in a full tuxedo doing a breakdance on the 31 bus today. Only in SF do you get classic elegance mixed with street flair.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about Gaudí, but the real vibe is in the tiny bars where locals still remember your name after one visit.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by how they cautiously approach patatas bravas – it’s always 'do I use the fork or just dive in?'
